title: Creation: God's Good World
summary: God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation. God made the world bright, full, and good. When you see trash outside or someone being careless, remember that God's world is a gift to care for, not just a place to use.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 1:1-2:3. Watch for what the story shows about creation.

tell_it: God made the world bright, full, and good. God created light, sky, land, plants, animals, and people. Everything God made showed His power and goodness.
understand_it: The point is not that creation is impressive by itself. God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation. When you see trash outside or someone being careless, remember that God's world is a gift to care for, not just a place to use.
age_5_7_explanation: God made the world bright, full, and good.
age_8_11_explanation: God created light, sky, land, plants, animals, and people. Everything God made showed His power and goodness. Kids can notice creation in the choices people make, not only in the famous part of the story. God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation.
teen_explanation: God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation. When you see trash outside or someone being careless, remember that God's world is a gift to care for, not just a place to use. Teens can also notice the tension in the passage: faith is not always easy, immediate, or admired by everyone nearby.
key_truths: God made the world good and made people to know Him and care for His creation.
Creation: God's Good World shows creation through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When you see trash outside or someone being careless, remember that God's world is a gift to care for, not just a place to use.
life_application: When you see trash outside or someone being careless, remember that God's world is a gift to care for, not just a place to use.
